function.name: create_assignment
function.description: Creates a new assignment (courseWork) in Google Classroom. Call this when the teacher wants to assign homework, a lab, or a test.

description.description: Detailed description of the task. Leave blank if the user did not specify one.

max_points.description: Maximum score for the task (e.g., 10, 100). If not specified, pass 100.

due_date.description: The submission deadline in YYYY-MM-DD format. If the user asks for 'by tomorrow', calculate this date using get_current_time.
